page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn8v.48xlarge is a bare-metal, compute-optimized GPU server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. The hardware profile features 192 dedicated virtual CPUs driven by Intel Xeon 8469C processors with an x86_64 architecture operating at a base frequency of 2.6 GHz. Memory capacity is provisioned at 1024.0 GB of RAM, providing roughly 5.33 GB of system memory per vCPU.

Hardware acceleration is anchored by an array of 8 GPUs delivering a combined 768 GB of total video RAM. Network capability is backed by a 170 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, accommodating large cluster communication and substantial inter-node data transfers. The instance includes no complimentary public IPv4 addresses and does not provide local instance storage, requiring all persistent storage and operational data pools to be mounted via network-attached cloud storage services.

This server architecture provides substantial compute and memory density, balancing dense host resources with extreme parallel processing capabilities. From a cost efficiency perspective, bundling 8 high-memory accelerators with massive core allocations reduces physical node footprint, though it introduces operational reliance on network storage for stateful workloads. Workloads appropriate for ecs.ebmgn8v.48xlarge include large-scale deep learning model training, distributed AI inference, high-performance computing, and parallel data science tasks requiring high accelerator density.
